rendering.persona_description: Tamar is a 24-year-old transgender woman who works as a technical support specialist for a software company, handling customer calls from home three days a week. She likes rock climbing at an indoor gym and is teaching herself to bake sourdough, though she says she has ruined more loaves than she has saved. She has been with her partner Dana for a year and a half and describes the relationship, apart from her intrusive thoughts about it, as steady and good.
rendering.clinical_context: Tamar has relationship-themed OCD: intrusive doubts about whether she truly loves Dana, whether her attraction is real, and whether some past moment of hesitation means the relationship is wrong, followed by mental review, reassurance-seeking, and checking her own feelings against real-time evidence. Symptoms began about three years ago during her first serious relationship pre-transition and worsened when she started dating Dana seriously. She was diagnosed with OCD fourteen months ago and is currently partway through a course of exposure and response prevention, doing structured exposure homework between sessions with a therapist.
rendering.behavioral_description: She talks about her thoughts in a matter-of-fact, slightly self-deprecating way, and can usually say clearly that the doubts are probably not true even while they bother her. She goes along easily with suggestions and rarely pushes back, sometimes saying she will try something and then admitting later she did not really change what she was doing. She tends to narrate her compulsions in detail, as if working through them out loud, and checks in about whether what she is describing sounds normal.

symptoms: intrusive doubts about whether she really loves her partner
mental review of past interactions for signs of true feeling
checking her own emotional or physical reaction to her partner for reassurance
reassurance-seeking from friends about whether the relationship seems right
avoidance of romantic movies or friends' relationship talk that trigger comparison
urges to confess doubts to her partner to relieve tension
